Scammed and received rude service
May 2019 • Couples
I already wrote a Google Review, but I was so baffled by what happened that I feel the need to say it again here. 
We were two and went there at 8pm on a Tuesday. They had a board saying “happy hour, buy one get one free Hanoi beer between 12pm and 9pm”. I ordered two and got charged for both. When I pointed out the board with the offer I was told “no”. Then when I tried to explain nicely the waiter, all of a sudden, could not speak English. Quite interesting. Maybe better remove the board if the offer is “no”?

Continue like this and customers will run away.

Music, staff and atmosphere: Perfection!
Oct 2018 • Friends
We didn't plan to go here as some of the group members would like to have just a beer but all were convinced eventually. The whole group of friends from work (10 people in total) was dancing the night out thanks to the list of music here which was AMAZING! 

The pub had a good mix of both locals and foreigners. Drinks here might be 1.5 time more expensive in comparison with the other bars nearby but it's worth it because we're all happy to pay more when the staff here was very accommodating, drinks were so good (highly recommend those buckets that were perfectly strong - credits to the bartender!!).
